column3: Starlet Motel then Moses garage, Port Gellhorn
column4:
Chapter 1 warehouse lead / Chapter 2 completion; inspect reception missing-person poster (L2/LT), then enter overgrown warehouse across from Moses via right-wall crawl gap. Photograph 3 locker-room clues. If the motel is inaccessible, inspect the poster outside the 247 south of Delights. The curved-roof warehouse is north/northeast of Moses; use the crawl opening on its northeast wall if the shutter is locked. Look for the red-lit room leading to the lockers. The illustrated mission marker is just north of Moses. The red-lit room leads to the three photograph lockers.
Nov 26 GPS directory distinguishes the warehouse photo clue from the three victims; the separate Chapter 2 clue marker describes the motel poster and warehouse sequence.
The Nov 26 GPS directory also lists two unexplained clue markers at game-map X -6471, Y 1037 and X -6974, Y 1163, categorized near Capri. They are not additional victims; their role in the investigation is unconfirmed.
PC Gamer (Nov 26) reports a Chapter 1 start as Jason: enter the warehouse directly, without the motel poster. Both characters must be available to finish in Chapter 2. The early route adds a Jason-to-Lucia text exchange. Check the phone Gallery for all three Creepy Photos before searching.
Alternate poster: beside the payphone outside a Port Gellhorn shop. The warehouse is off Cavalry St; find the lockers behind hanging sheets.

column3: Port Gellhorn junkyard east of Pay n Spray
column4: Open trunk of pink PRTYGRL car (another wreck stacked above). Inspect victim; report to Kelly County Tip Line. Susanne Keeble: look for the No Parking sign at the junkyard fence; the pink car is beyond it. The linked map image shows all three victim sites. Follow the driveway around the building to the rear fence along the main road.\nPC Gamer identifies the wreck as a pink DeVanity; the junkyard is opposite the drive-in theater. After the second discovery the tip-line investigator may answer directly.\nAccess the scrap yard off US-9.

column3: Northern Port Gellhorn abandoned trailer park
column4: Under rusted water tower find pale blue-green trailer. Lift loose floorboard on right and report second victim. Patrick Murray: west of Hank's Waffles, enter the trailer nearest the water tower fence; a barking dog is reported by the doorway. The linked map image shows all three victim sites. GTA6GPS plots a missing-tourist marker near Hank's Waffles at X -6337, Y 4557, consistent with the trailer-park clue. Confirm the victim in the trailer. The trailer is beyond the water tower if approaching from the south. Inspect the floor in the green trailer.\nThe Nov 26 walkthrough enters the blue trailer from its rear, along the fence. The water tower shadow is a landmark.

column3: Marsh west of Port Gellhorn near Wild Hog Point
column4: At broken leaning tree beside small marsh lake, inspect half-sunken rusty station wagon; report third victim. Beware alligators. Donald Miller: locate the C-shaped pond between the town and airstrip, just before the Wild Hog Point bridge. The linked map image shows all three victim sites. The map shows a small pond beside the airstrip. Approach on foot from the road to the west.\nNov 26 GPS identifies the sunken-car location near the Yosemite 1500 marker west of town.\nPC Gamer identifies this as a Borrachero Sound inlet southeast of the Wild Hog Point hangar. Match the airfield view from the tree to the photo.

column3: Moses garage warehouse; abandoned mine near Mount Kalaga
column4:
Return after 3 tip calls. Spoilers: go in alone for the optional partner kidnapping and mine rescue; follow phone message, get crowbar, free partner and confront Alvan West. Glasses are route-dependent; arrive together for the wearable reward. The follow-up starts after returning to the trophy room; the mine is in the Kalaga Reservoir area of Lummox County. Completing the mission reportedly increases the protagonists' relationship. Alternate walkthrough reports both protagonists must be active for the final tip-line call; then enter as Lucia. Solo versus paired entry may change the finale. Save before returning; Chapter 2 cleanup is recommended because later availability is disputed.
The Nov 26 GPS guide uses the same warehouse marker for the return visit.
PC Gamer (Nov 26) tested two branches: enter alone as either protagonist for the mine rescue, or arrive together for the partner intervention at the warehouse. The paired branch allows taking Alvan's glasses from his body. Both reportedly improve the relationship; no cash reward reported. Choose the paired branch if collecting the glasses. Save before returning.
The final mine entrance is timber-framed with a green light inside. After completion, the Kelly County Tip Line disappears from both phones.
